items.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock to Target This Week and 2 We Question
items.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.

items.title: Ex-Starbucks CFO joins Jack in the Box board
items.summary: The restaurant chain’s appointment of Rachel Ruggieri is part of its ongoing board refresh efforts as it continues a plan to pay down its debt and improve its capital structure.

items.title: Jack in the Box adds a former Starbucks exec to its board
items.summary: Rachel Ruggeri, who had been the coffee shop giant’s CFO, was named a director at the fast-food burger chain.

items.title: Starbucks opening tech hub in Chennai, India with 800 jobs
items.summary: The coffee chain signed an agreement with the Tamil Nadu state government to establish a global capability center in the southern Indian city

items.title: Jack in the Box Appoints Rachel Ruggeri to Board
items.summary: Jack in the Box Inc. announced that Rachel Ruggeri, former Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Starbucks Corporation, has been appointed to its Board of Directors as an independent director. The Company also announced that Michael Murphy will retire from the Board and will not stand for reelection at the Company’s 2027 Annual […]

items.title: Starbucks Plans Global Capability Centre in India, Reuters Reports
items.summary: Starbucks (NASDAQ:SBUX) is planning to establish a global capability centre in Chennai, India, with approximately 800 jobs expected to be created during the project’s initial phase, Reuters reported on Monday. The news agency cited a government source familiar with the plans.
